Paṭibhāganimittaṃ tu, upacārena sevato;Appeti paṭhamajjhāna-metthevaṃ samathe nayo.
Bahi maṭṭhamupaṭṭhāti, anto kuṇapapūritaṃ;Uggharantaṃ paggharantaṃ, navadvāramalassavaṃ.
Positampi ciraṃ kālaṃ, mamaṃkāramamāyitaṃ;Lahudujjanamittova, pīḷitaṃ sampadussati.
Anomo asamo dhīro,Lokahītaparakkamo;Sabbākāravaropeto,Accherabbhutapuggalo.
Ānubhāvavasippatto, āsabhaṇḍānaniccalo;Mahantamariyādoyamanantagatigocaro.
Phullaṃ padumasaṇḍaṃva, kapparukkhovalaṅkato;Nabhaṃva tārakākiṇṇaṃ, uttamo paṭidissati.
Upanissayavantānaṃ, ‘‘ehi passā’’ti dassiyo;Paccattameva viññūhi, veditabbo sabhāvato.
Sabbāsavasamugghātī, suddho sovatthiko sivo;Pihitāpāyakummaggo, maggo nibbānapattiyā.
Byasanopaddavāpeto, saṃklesamalanissaṭo;Ujusammattaniyato, paṭipattivisuddhiyā.
Cattāro ca paṭipannā, cattāro ca phale ṭhitā;Esa saṅgho ujubhūto, paññāsīlasamāhito.
Uttamadamathappatto, suvinīto mahesinā;Vijjāvimuttivodāto, ājānīyapathe ṭhito.
Ujumaggamadhiṭṭhāya, mārakāyappadālano;Aparājitasaṅgāmo, lalitodātavikkamo.
Kulaputtaalaṅkāro, pāpajallapavāhanaṃ;Anapāyi sugandhañca, mahāpurisasevitaṃ.
‘‘Suladdhā vata me laddhā, saddhā sugatasāsane;Sīlaṃ me yassa kalyāṇaṃ, parisuddhamakhaṇḍi
‘‘Dullabho vata me laddho,Mahālābho anappako;Yohamakkhalitācāro,Upaghātavivajjito.
‘‘Dhammaṅkuritasantāno, mūlajātosmi sāsane;Ujumaggaṃ samāruḷho, pihitā sabhayā disā.
Ujumaddavacittosmi, kālussiyavinissaṭo;Pāpasaṃklesavimukho, pāṇabhūtānukampako.
Te sabbepi ca mayhampi, vijjanti anupāyino;Saddhādikusalā dhammā, devadhammāti vissutā.
Upasantamidaṃ ṭhānamiti cinteti paṇḍito;Anupādānasaṃkliṭṭhamasaṅkhāramanāsavaṃ.
Appamāṇaṃ paṇītañca, sivaṃ paramamaccutaṃ;Anantaguṇamaccanta-mavikāramanāmayaṃ.
Vaṭṭānubandhavicchedo, bhavataṇhāvisosanaṃ;Sabbūpadhisamugghāto, dukkhanibbāpanaṃ sukhaṃ.
Palibodhasamucchedo, papañcaviniveṭhanaṃ;Sabbasaṅkhārasamatho, sabbalokavinissaṭo.
Pārisuddhikarā dhātu, bhavanissaraṇaṃ padaṃ;Uttamāriyasampatti, anomamamataṃ padaṃ.
Sabbathā bhaddamatulaṃ, nibbānamiti passato;Upasamānussatīti, bhāvanāyaṃ pavuccati.
Upanissayasampanno, patvā nibbedhamuttamaṃ;Diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaggiṃ, nibbāpeti anāsavo.
Animittamanaññātaṃ, maccānamidha jīvitaṃ;Kasirañca parittañca, tañca dukkhena saṃyutaṃ.
Sattāratanalaṅkārā, caturiddhisamuggatā;Cakkavattī mahātejā, rājamaṇḍalasobhino.
Addhuvaṃ jīvitaṃ nicca-maccantaṃ maraṇaṃ mama;Sabhāvo maraṇanteva, viseso pana jīvitaṃ.
Tadetaṃ pana bhāvetvā, upacārasamāhito;Nibbedabahulo hoti, appamādadhurandharo.
Kesā lomā nakhā dantā, taco maṃsaṃ nahāru ca;Aṭṭhi ca miñja vakkaṃ ca, hadayaṃ yakanaṃ tat
Pubbo ca lohitaṃ sedo,Medo assu vasātha vā;Kheḷo siṅghāṇikā ceva,Lasikā muttamiccapi.
Vicittachavisañchannā, tacabhattasamohitā;Parissavaparikliṭṭhā, kuthitā pūtigandhitā.
Dhoviyantāpi satataṃ, ajahantā malassavaṃ;Sugandhānuvilittāpi, duggandhapariṇāmino.
Ahaṃkāramamattena, vissaṭṭhasukhasaṅgahā;Saṅghāṭaghanasambaddhā, sammohenti mahājanaṃ.
Vaṇṇasaṇṭhānagandhā ca,Āsayokāsato tato;Vibhāveyyāsubhākāra-Mekekasmiṃ tu pañcadhā.
Asubhākāramārabbha, bhāvanā ce pavattati;Kammaṭṭhānaṃ paṭikkūlaṃ, paṭhamajjhānikaṃ siyā.
Soyamajjhattaṃ nibbinno, bahiddhā ca nirālayo;Ubbegabahulo yogī, pamādamativattati.
Pañcannaṃ na ṭhapetabbaṃ, heṭṭhā na dasatopari;Netabbamanupubbena, gaṇetabbamakhaṇḍitaṃ.
Cittaṃ samāhitaṃ hoti, upacārasamādhinā;Upaklesā pahiyyanti, paṭibhāge samuṭṭhite.
Sabbakalyāṇadhammānaṃ, avamaṅgalamuṭṭhitaṃ;Hitārambhasamugghātī, antarāyasamāgamo.
Byāpādamattasambhava-mattaghaññāya kevalaṃ;Upalāḷenti dummedhā, ghoramāsīvisaṃ yathā.
Nāvabujjhanti dummedhā, cetosaṅkappavāyunā;Ukkāmukhāmivāditta-mujjalantā punappunaṃ.
Duppaṭippāditārambhā, kodhasaṅkhobhamohitā;Dhammāmatarasassādaṃ, na vindanti aviddasu.
Codayamānā dukkhehi, klesāciṇṇamalīmahā;Pāpakammehi pūrentā, senti maccupathe ciraṃ.
Kodhānalajalāseko,Sokopāyāsanāsanaṃ;Āghātasallaniddhārī,Upanāhavimocanaṃ.
Sabbadukkhasamugghāti, sukhupaṭṭhānamuttamaṃ;Byasanodayavicchedo, bhayabheravaniggamo.
Cetopasādasandhāno, pāsādikaphalāvaho;Pavaro bodhisambhāro, narānaranisevito.
Titikkhāguṇasampanno, pāṇabhūtānukampako;Anākulitakammanto, sorato sakhilo suci.
Akkhobho adhivāsento,Sabbānatthe parissaye;Bhīmasaṅgāmāvacaro,Hatthināgova sobhati.
Sabbe sattā ca pāṇā ca, bhūtā jīvā ca puggalā;Abyāpajjā tathāverā, anīghā ca sukhedhino.
Tato anīgho ekaggo, upasantamanoratho;Jhānattikaṃ catukkaṃ vā, mettācetovimuttiyā.
Tathāsevitasantāno,Mettācetovimuttiyā;Karuṇābhāvanāyoga-Mārabheyya tato paraṃ.
Dīgharattādhimuttāya, devalokasamiddhiyā;Devakāyā vihāyanti, akāmā parivattino.
Iccevamanukampanto, sabbasattepi sabbathā;Sabbadukkhasamugghātaṃ, patthento karuṇāyati.
Sabbālayasamugghātaṃ, patvā lokuttaraṃ padaṃ;Paṭipassaddhadarathā, sukhaṃ modantanappakaṃ.
‘‘Bhayamaggamatikkantā, dukkhasaṅghāṭanissaṭā;Khemamaggamanuppattā, pītisampattiphullitā.
‘‘Samaggā suhitā cete, paṭisandhānapesalā;Sampattimabhivedenti, kalyāṇaguṇabhūsitā’’.
Niratthakavihesāyaṃ, maññe lokavicāraṇā;Santametaṃ paṇītañca, yadidaṃ tatrupekkhanaṃ.
Attani duggate mitte, majjhatteti yathākkamaṃ;Paṭhamaṃ bhāvanāyogamārabhitvā tato paraṃ.
Asaṅkhotitasantānā, tāhi bhūtānukampakā;Viharantuttamā brahmavihārāti tato matā.
Iccābhivuddhimicchanto, dukkhāpagamanaṃ tathā;Samiddhe anumodanto, upekkhanto ca pīṇite.
Mātāva dahare putte, gilāne yobbane ṭhite;Sakiccapasute ceva, catudhā sampavattati.
Parissayā pahīyanti, vigacchanti cupaddavā;Devatāpi ca rakkhanti, amuyhantaṃ anākulaṃ.
Asaṃhīro asaṃkuppo, sabbāvatthāsu paṇḍito;Samaṃ pavattitārambho, lokamesonugaṇhati.
Saddhādikusalā dhammā, pavaḍḍhanti akhaṇḍitā;Sambuddhicariyānañca, mahattaṃ tassa pākaṭaṃ.
Akicchapaṭivedhāya, pādakajjhānamuttamaṃ;Uju cekāyano maggo, brahmalokūpapattiyā.
Tapovanamidaṃ hitvā, ramaṇīyamanākulaṃ;Āhārahetu gantabbo, gāmo gāmajanākulo.
Tatthāsuciparikliṭṭhe, dujjanāvārasaṅkare;Dīnamesayatuttiṭṭhaṃ, gehe gehe tu bhojanaṃ.
Pittasemhaparibyuḷhaṃ, pubbalohitamissitaṃ;Pavisantaṃ paṭikkūlaṃ, jegucchaṃ dhikkatāsivaṃ.
Kucchito soyamāhāro,Kāyāsucinisevano;Nissandamalaniṭṭhāno,Upaklesaphalāvaho.
Ahitodayamaggoyaṃ, bhayabheravasambhavo;Byasanāgamanadvāraṃ, apāyāvahitaṃ mukhaṃ.
Bhāventassa paṭikkūla-saññamevaṃ vibhāvino;Upacārapathaṃ patvā, cittaṃ hoti samāhitaṃ.
Uddhañcādhogamāvātā, kucchikoṭṭhāsayā tathā;Aṅgamaṅgānusārī ca, chadhānāpānamiccapi.
Āyu usmā ca viññāṇaṃ, yadā kāyaṃ jahantimaṃ;Apaviddho tadā seti, niratthaṃva kaliṅgaraṃ.
Itthaṃ dhātuvavatthānaṃ, katvā tadanusārato;Upādārūpadhamme ca, nāmadhamme ca sabbathā.
Āruppaṃ pana bhāvento, kammaṭṭhānamanāvilaṃ;Catukkapañcakajjhānaṃ, patvā kasiṇamaṇḍale.
Pattharitvāna yaṃ kiñci, ākāsakasiṇaṃ vinā;Ugghāṭeti tamevātha, kasiṇaṃ dhitimā sato.
Tassāvajjanasampannaṃ, upāyapaṭipāditaṃ;Kasiṇāpagamākāsaṃ, cintanārabbha vattati.
Tattha vuttanayeneva, bhāventassopacārato;Paṭhamāruppamappeti, ākāsānantagocare.
Suppaṇītatarā honti, uddhamuddhaṃ yathākkamaṃ;Cātumahārājikādidibbasampattiyo yathā.
Vipassanto yathābhūtaṃ, sacchikatvā phaluttamaṃ;Ubhatobhāgavimutto, arahāti pavuccati.
Saraṃ pubbenivāsañca, passaṃ sugatiduggatiṃ;Yathākammaṃ vipākañca, pajānantamanāgataṃ.
Yathāsambhavamiccevamupāyakusalo muni;Upanissayasampanno, abhiññamadhigacchati.
11. Ekādasamo paricchedo
Dvidhā samuṭṭhānadhurā, tividhā bhūmiyo matā;Tividhābhinivesā ca, sarīraṃ tu catubbidhaṃ.
Kalāpato sammasanaṃ, udayabbayadassanaṃ;Pariññātīraṇā nāma, dutiyā bhūmi bhāsitā.
Uppādavayabhāvopi, lakkhaṇattayasādhako;Paccayākāramārabbha, lakkhīyati visesato.
Tasmā sammasanañāṇaṃ, udayabbayadassanaṃ;Kaṅkhāvitaraṇāyaṃ tu, saṅgayhati visuddhiyaṃ.
Tato kathenti akliṭṭhamudayabbayadassanaṃ;Ādiṃ katvā paṭipadāñāṇadassanasuddhiyaṃ.
Upaklesavisuddho hi, punadevodayabbayaṃ;Adhiṭṭhahitvā bhaṅgādi-ñāṇehi paṭipajjati.
Tathā cābhinavuppanne, bhijjamāne vipassato;Saṃvegakaḍḍhitaṃ ñāṇaṃ, bhaṅgādimanutiṭṭhati.
Addhuvā ca asārā ca, vibhavā ca vināsino;Saṅkhatā vipariṇāma-dhammā ittarakālikā.
Dukkhā ca dukkhavatthū ca, abhiṇhaparipīḷitā;Rogā gaṇḍā ca sallā ca, aghato ca upaddavā.
Tilāni tilayanteva, ucchuyanteva ucchuyo;Udayabbayāvassaṃ te, pīḷayanti abhiṇhaso.
Cavantā upapajjantā, rukkhasākhaṃva makkaṭo;Dukkhamekaṃ vimuccanti, tato gaṇhanti cāparaṃ.
Na kiñcettha apekkhitvā, samaggā honti paccayā;Na janetuṃ na sakkonti, samaggā ca kudācana
Apubbābhinavuppatti, uppādoti pakāsito;Pubbāpariyasandhānaṃ, paṭisandhīti bhāsitā.
Paccayādhīnadhammānaṃ, uppādavayalakkhitā;Aniccatānimittaṭṭhā, pavattesu na pākaṭā.
Iti saṅkhāradhammesu, nimittākāranicchitaṃ;Aniccalakkhaṇaṃ dhīro, nijjhāyati niyāmato.
Uppādābhinavākāraṃ, atikkamma tato paraṃ;Jarājaccaritā hutvā, bhañjamānā kathaṃ sukhā.
Byāpāravasitākāraṃ, saṅkhārānaṃ vipassato;Nimitte ca pavatte ca, upaṭṭhāti anattato.
Tamevaṃ paṭivijjhanto, maññatānattalakkhaṇaṃ;Vipassanārasassādī, saṃvegabahulo bhave.
Uppādavayabhāvena, dissamānā hi saṅkhatā;Pubbāparavivekena, dassenti tadaniccataṃ.
Jātāppaṇihitā nāma, muñcantī paṇidhiṃ tathā;Nirālayābhinivesā, ādīnavānupassanā.

Dosamūlaṃ pakāsenti, dosamohadvihetukaṃ;Vicikicchāsahagataṃ, uddhaccasahitanti ca.
